## Context / Problem

The parent epic's second engine is a single Opus 5.5 agent that reviews a plan against the code it will touch and reports findings, as an alternative to the 4-pass pipeline. Its starting prompt is the operator's raw review prompt (`~/plan-review-bakeoff/harness/RAWO5_PROMPT.md`), which asks for a JSON array of findings with `id`, `title`, `description`, `severity` (`blocker | major | minor | trivial`), `evidence` and `suggested_fix`, and forbids writing the tree. rebar takes no dependency on that repository: the text is copied into rebar's prompt registry and adapted.

## Approach

Add the engine as its own module, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/agentic.py`, beside `orchestrator.py` and not inside any near-cap module (the epic's size constraint). It makes ONE call on rebar's existing runner: `RunRequest` (`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:58`) with `execution_mode="agentic"`, `mode="structured"`, a new packaged output schema for the finding array, and the frontier model class, so the Bedrock-first provider chain, its Anthropic fallback, tracing and usage logging apply unchanged. Budget and timeout use existing `RunRequest` fields only, at the values ADR 0123 adopts: `tool_step_limit=60`, `iteration_limit=80`, model-maximum output tokens, per-request timeout `cfg.timeout_s`; effort comes from the per-model table the model-upgrade ticket adds [rebar:beaten-natural-grouse].

Tools are exactly the runner's agentic surface (`runner.py:380-390`): `filesystem_tools` (`read_file`, `list_directory`, `search_files`), `grounding_tools`, and `rebar_tools` with `comment_ticket` withheld. The call runs inside the same gate session as the pipeline, so `assert_gated` (`runner.py:362-369`) holds and `cfg.repo_path` is the attested snapshot of the reviewed ref; `_safe_path` (`src/rebar/llm/fs_tools.py:24`) refuses traversal. No write or execute tool exists on that surface, which is how "cannot write the checkout or run commands" is enforced, and a test pins the tool-name set.

The prompt goes into the packaged registry as `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_agentic.md` (the directory `prompts.py:119` serves). Adaptations: `@@PLAN_DOC@@` becomes the plan material rebar already assembles for the pipeline (`context_assembly.assemble_context`, including prerequisite blocks), `@@REVIEW_ROOT@@` becomes "the repository your file tools read", the "write to `@@DEST@@`" instruction becomes "return the findings as your structured output", the review criteria context is appended from the same registry `rebar explain <criterion>` renders, each finding gains a `criteria` list of registry criterion ids, possibly empty, matching the pipeline's finding shape, and the bakeoff's scoring language is replaced by the epic's severity rule (only `blocker` blocks). The no-dollar-figures line is kept.

The workflow gets an `agentic_review` step in `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` that runs `when` the precheck set `run_llm` AND the engine is `agentic`, replacing the not-yet-available raise the engine-switch ticket left [rebar:skilled-cepevorous-naga]. Turning the agent's findings into the verdict and sidecar is the adapter ticket's job; this ticket returns the validated finding list.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/agentic.py (new)
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_agentic.md (new prompt)
- src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_agentic_findings.schema.json (new output schema)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml (`agentic_review` step)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py (remove the not-yet-available raise)
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic.py (new)

## Testing

- Happy path: with `FakeRunner` (`runner.py:194`) returning a fixed finding array, the engine returns the validated list and the request carries `execution_mode="agentic"`, the frontier class and the new schema.
- Read-only: a test builds the agentic tool surface and asserts the tool names are exactly the read-only set, with no `comment_ticket`, no write and no execute tool.
- Failure/edge: malformed output (schema-invalid or non-JSON) and a runner error each surface as an error the adapter can map to INDETERMINATE, never an empty PASS; an empty array is a valid no-findings result.
- Zero-call invariant: a floor-blocked ticket under `engine="agentic"` makes zero runner calls.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic.py` passes, covering the request shape, the read-only tool set, malformed output and the zero-call floor case.
- [ ] The prompt is served from the packaged registry and contains no `@@` placeholders and no reference to the bakeoff repository (`git grep -nF plan-review-bakeoff -- src` prints nothing).
- [ ] `agentic.py` is under the 800-line cap and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports `new=0 increased=0`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
